name: Northcourt Glacier Indoor Ball
description: The Northcourt Glacier Indoor Ball is a 26-hole indoor ball made for gym floors and community-center courts. Its softer TPE blend gives a quieter, lower bounce that lengthens rallies, and the ice-blue color stays visible against wood floors and bright overhead lighting.
care_instructions: Store at room temperature out of direct sunlight. Replace a ball once it goes soft or develops flat spots, typically after 20 to 30 hours of indoor play.
